messages.subject: Re: [knitr] slides with css
parts:
Perhaps you can wrap specific slides with specific div's, and define
CSS for them, e.g.

<div class="foo-1">
content
</div>

And in CSS,

div.foo-1 {
font-size: 9px;
}

Regards,
Yihui

>
>
>> body, td {
>> font-size: 14px;
>> }
>> code.r{
>> font-size: 10px;
>> }

>> }
>

messages.author: d3a561bb056381bf
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] slides with css
parts:
Dear Yihui,
thanks for your answer.
It works for changing the font-size locally with text ouside the r-code.
However, the r-code itself remains at the global size.

## begin R-code for toy example ----------------------------------------

# *.md
cat(
'<div class="foo-1">
* bla
```{r this}
sessionInfo()                
```
</div>',
file = 'report_knit_.md')

# *.css
cat(
'<style type="text/css">

system('firefox report.html')

## end R-code --------------------------------------------

Do you have any ideas to change the r-code size?
Regards,
René

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] slides with css
parts:
You probably need !important in CSS to increase the priority of your
custom rules and also define the font-size on div.foo-1.code.r (google
for something like "CSS precedence rules" or "Cascading order" and
learn them).

Regards,
Yihui
